articles.summary: Six AI SDR products compared on what they send, what they cost and who they fit, plus the seventh option: building the SDR on GTM infrastructure you own, so the targeting, the research and the copy stay yours when the vendor changes.
articles.title: AI SDR Alternatives in 2026: 11x, Artisan, AiSDR, Alta, Amplemarket, Unify, and Building Your Own

articles.summary: OpenClaw and Hermes run on your machine, answer in Slack or WhatsApp, and load skills from ClawHub. What they lack is GTM data and the provider accounts behind it. How to install Cargo's skills in both, sign the agent in, schedule a weekly list, and when the job should move off the agent and into a play.
articles.title: OpenClaw for GTM: Give Your Agent Prospecting, Enrichment and Outbound Skills
